notes: The verse-opening waw carries the *that* of the presentative frame it opens the apodosis of, which is why no *and* is written for it (rule 45).
עַל־יְדֵי → *beside* is fused as one preposition unit plus its separate suffix, rather than marking יְדֵי unrepresented; the one-English-word condition is met exactly as in rule 30's בְּיַד → *by*.
רֹעוֹת keeps only *feeding*: the gapped copula is licensed by the parallel predicate and the ASV writes no separate word (rule 34).
